content:
Nina Eng: seeing a small cluster of attach failures + API 502s in ap-southeast2-rtx since 04:10 local. Noticing controller-manager churn and kubelet volume detach timeouts.
Ava SRE: copy, just flagged apiserver_5xx_alerts. Leader election toggling in controller-manager every ~20s.
Ben Infra: any infra events? I can see a routing flap on the vm-subnet around 04:08 (cloud logs). Might be BGP session reset with our transit.
Ravi: pulling etcd metrics -> peer latency spike and Raft election increase at 04:09. Logs show `i/o timeout` and `grpc: the client connection is closing`.
Sam O: GPU attach queue length increased too. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools/gpu-attach-ops?panel=6 shows failed_attach_rate jump x6. Finance FYI: attach ops cost us per-op on some providers.
Nina Eng: snippet from controller-manager:
```
E0319 04:10:13.582 controller-manager: failed to attach volume vol-rtx-432: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
W0319 04:10:13.585 controller-manager: leader-elect lost lease: etcdserver: request timed out
```
Ava SRE: interestingly, some nodes are reporting MTU 1500 while others are 9000 after the network config rollout yesterday — fragmentation might be causing larger packets (etcd heartbeats/KV) to be split resulting in retransmits.
Ben Infra: confirmed — the config management applied jumbo frames to the node groups but a subset in the rtx nodepool didn't pick up due to a tag mismatch. Rolling a fix now.
Ravi: mitigation idea: lower controller-manager attach concurrency and increase attach timeout/backoff to reduce pressure while we fix network. Canary the change?
Sam O: +1. Also suggest temporarily lowering attach-controller workers on affected nodepools only, and gate heavy attach paths behind conditional retries.
Nina Eng: I'll patch controller-manager args: `--concurrent-attaches=4` `--attach-detach-reconcile-sync-period=2m` and increase csi timeouts if present. Pushing canary to 1 replica in us-east-1 first.
InfraBot: [action] Created incident INC-2026-2284, severity=high, owner=Ben Infra, notify=#oncall.
Ben Infra: fixing the tag mismatch now, reapplying MTU=9000 via DaemonSet job to 8 nodes.
Ava SRE: also enabling apiserver read fallback to eu-west1 for control-plane reads for non-critical ops to reduce pressure on local etcd. Can we do that safely?
Sam O: yes for reads that don't need strong consistency. We'll route non-leader traffic to fallback region. Ava, coordinate with networking.
Ravi: canary applied. Monitoring logs: leader election jitter reduced on the canary replica within 2 minutes. apiserver 5xx rate trending down.
Nina Eng: MTU job finished on 8 nodes, still 2 nodes pending due to SSH key rotation artifact. Scheduling a patch window for those.
Ben Infra: pushing config to remaining nodes, will validate with `ping -M dont -s 8972` and `ip link show`.
Nina Eng: verifying etcd snapshots and leader health: `etcdctl endpoint status --write-out=table` shows stable leader and healthy peers after MTU fix.
Ava SRE: monitoring for 30m window. If stable, we'll roll controller-manager change globally.
Sam O: Finance note: estimated attach retry billing bump ~350 USD for the 20-minute window. Adding to incident notes.
InfraBot: [update] INC-2026-2284 severity=investigating -> degraded. Condition: awaiting 30m stability.
Ravi: 04:17 UTC apiserver 5xx back to baseline, attach failures down to near-zero. Keeping canary for another 10m before roll.
Nina Eng: drafting postmortem blurb: root cause = partial MTU misconfiguration after rollout + transient BGP flap -> packet fragmentation and etcd latency -> control plane leader election churn -> controller-manager attach thrash. Will include remediation items: improve config tagging, preflight MTU verification, and controller-manager safer defaults.
Sam O: great. Please add finance and customer-impact sections. Thanks for the quick response team. :thumbsup:
